headline.en: Your book leans hard into semiconductors, and today's desk read there is Cautious — a bounce, not a turn.
headline.zh: 你的账本重仓半导体，而研究台今日对该板块的研判是「谨慎」—— 是反弹，不是反转。

population.disclosure_en: This read describes the 9 names on your watchlists, equal weighted — not a position book.
population.disclosure_zh: 此判读描述你观察列表中的 9 只个股，按等权计算 — 并非持仓。
population.label_zh: 观察列表结构 — 等权

lines.en: 41% of your book is Technology — today's desk read on Technology is Cautious (a bounce, not a turn), so your effective diversification is thinner than it looks.
lines.zh: 你账本的 41% 在科技板块 —— 研究台今日对科技的研判是「谨慎」（是反弹，不是反转），所以你的有效分散度比看上去更薄。

lines.en: 3 of your 9 names report earnings inside 10 days — AVGO is first, on Jul 29.
lines.zh: 你 9 只标的中有 3 只将在 10 天内发布财报 —— AVGO 最早，7 月 29 日。

lines.en: 2 of your names sit in Buy now lanes; NVDA has its entry gate shut for now.
lines.zh: 你有 2 只标的处于「现在买入」通道；NVDA 的入场闸门目前关闭。

lines.en: The filings desks touched 2 of your names this week: a Congress buy in NVDA and a fund trim in AAPL.
lines.zh: 本周备案台触及你 2 只标的：NVDA 出现一笔国会买入，AAPL 出现一笔基金减持。
